description: Reviewed rules with their conditions, provenance and remaining limits.

detail.scope: Selected reviewed rules, with their original authority, conditions and limits. This is not an exhaustive mechanics guide.

name: Combat

rule_views.conditions: Developer Wynfir answers mrgbg about troops sent between own villages; screenshot received 18 September 2026. Displayed times 16:26 and 16:28, message date/timezone not visible.
rule_views.limits: Developer-confirmed gameplay statement, not a new Codex UI observation. Reinforcement, redirection and merging are different operations; no navigation path or additional merging conditions established.
rule_views.statement: The receiving village cannot launch attacks or raids using troops merely stationed there as reinforcements.
rule_views.title: Stationed reinforcements cannot attack from the host

rule_views.statement: Troops sent as reinforcements to another village you own still belong to their original village.
rule_views.title: Reinforcements keep their home village
